summary: Culls non-visible vehicles per frame. Gets the session interface via VirtualDispatchHelper on dword_5EA510 and either skips the culling pass (when a session flag at interface+112 is set, or vehicle count dword_5C329C is within the visible-index bound dword_7CFC8C) or, when culling is required, transforms each active vehicle position (read from the vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0) into camera space using a camera orientation and EulerToRotationMatrix, sorts vehicles by planar distance with sub_5890AA/FloatComparator, and marks the nearest dword_7CFC8C vehicles visible in a byte work buffer. A transition loop then starts engine sound for newly visible vehicles and clears flags/UI for newly hidden ones. Called by RenderScreenSave (004B40A0).

local_names.v26/v27/v28: camera Euler angles read at session interface+24; yaw negated via 3.1415927 - yaw before matrix build
local_names.v29: 3x3 camera-space rotation matrix built by EulerToRotationMatrix

local_names.v31: sorted distance array produced by sub_5890AA

operations.description: VirtualDispatchHelper called on &dword_5EA510 to obtain the session interface pointer

Culling pass is skipped when the session flag at interface+112 is non-zero OR vehicle count dword_5C329C is not greater than the visible-index bound dword_7CFC8C; only the visibility work buffer is (re)initialised in that case
Skip path: when dword_5C329C is positive the byte buffer v30 is filled with 0x01 for that many bytes (memset pattern with the constant 0x01010101 visible in the decompiler artifact)
Culling path requires the camera object pointer dword_7C54E0 to be non-null; the function returns early when it is null
Camera position read at dword_7C54E0+13536/+13540/+13544 and camera Euler angles read at session interface+24; yaw negated with 3.1415927 - yaw to build the view orientation
EulerToRotationMatrix builds the camera-space rotation matrix v29 from the Euler angle triple

For each vehicle pointer in dword_7C54F0[0..count): reads vehicle position at +3384/+3388/+3392, transforms the relative vector into camera space via the rotation matrix, stores planar squared distance at v30[4*i+104] and depth with a negative-depth clamp (v13 * 0.40000001) into the depth slot
sub_5890AA sorts the distance array v31 with the FloatComparator callback (element size 4, count = dword_5C329C), yielding an ascending distance ranking
Visibility threshold taken from sorted distance array index dword_7CFC8C; each vehicle is marked visible (byte 1) in v30 when its planar squared distance is below that threshold

Transition loop diffs the new visibility bytes against the previous ones; on a transition to visible AudioSoundEffectController is called with the vehicle's +4180 field, on transition to hidden FlagFieldBitManipulation is called twice and UIWidgetRecursiveStateUpdate once
Invoked by RenderScreenSave (004B40A0) during frame render
